searchText: Need an `ethereum` GitHub organization admin to block this user from the organization repositories. Instructions for how to block: <https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/blocking-a-user-from-your-organization> I will try sharing the message and above instructions.
